SorafsPopMembershipRequestV1.description: Generate a proof from local wallet custody. All four fields are required and included in the exact action authorization. The presentation binding authenticates the intended recipient or action independently of the challenge/context nullifier domain.

SorafsPopNonzeroHex32V1.description: One nonzero 32-byte value as exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters without a prefix. The all-zero value is rejected.

leaf_bytes_hex.description: Canonical lowercase hexadecimal leaf bytes. Runtime verification requires the decoded length to equal leaf_length.

SorafsReplicationNonzeroHex32V1.description: Canonical non-zero lowercase hexadecimal encoding of one 32-byte identity or digest.

canonical_order_b64.description: Exact canonical Norito `ReplicationOrderV1` payload, limited to 256 KiB before base64 encoding.

issued_by.description: Canonical domainless I105 issuing account identifier.

error.description: Bounded diagnostic text. Clients must branch on the HTTP status rather than matching this text.

Verification requires independently selected signed genesis or a complete authenticated checkpoint and consecutive native decisions. anchor_freshness.description: Anchor freshness bound A pinned at creation: a lane block anchored below h - A is stale when merged at global height h.

The instance is null while the node runs none (before activation, or when its instance failed to start). This observation is not an authenticated finality proof.

Fetch content bundle bytes (path captures the remaining path segments). Canonical request-authentication headers are optional for public bundles. Role- and sponsor-gated bundles require either the complete account/signature/timestamp/nonce proof set or a canonical witness. Public responses may use the manifest's configured public cache policy; role- and sponsor-gated responses always return `Cache-Control: private, no-store` and vary over all canonical authentication headers. Existing protected bundles authenticate and authorize before file lookup: absent or invalid proof returns 401, authorization mismatch returns 403, and a missing file returns 404 only after successful authorization. Unknown or expired bundles also return 404. The Torii origin is a byte-delivery boundary, not a web-hosting origin: safe inert media retain their type, while active, unknown, or invalid media types are returned as `application/octet-stream` attachments. Every successful response sends `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` and a restrictive sandbox Content Security Policy without changing byte or range semantics.

get.description: Return a bounded exact-cursor projection of canonical Norito, Ed25519-signed, globally sequenced and hash-chained payload-free receipts from one exact signed checkpoint. The only accepted genesis query wire is expected_checkpoint_digest_hex then limit, in that order. A continuation inserts after_sequence then after_receipt_digest_hex between those fields. Percent/plus aliases, reordered fields, duplicate or empty fields, omitted explicit limits, and non-canonical decimal or lowercase hexadecimal values are rejected. after_sequence and after_receipt_digest_hex must be supplied together and match the exact retained signed receipt; sequence-only or digest-only continuation is rejected. A checkpoint change returns 409 rather than silently repaginating. The response returns the signed checkpoint_anchor with authoritative store generation/predecessor pins, its exact signed compaction_archive_head, digest-bound page_limit, predecessor and next_cursor exact pairs, canonical projection_norito_b64, projection_digest_hex, has_more, and receipts; it never emits a sequence-only continuation. X-Iroha canonical authentication and the explicit sorafs_evidence_auditor or sorafs_legal_reviewer role are required; operator role alone is insufficient.

API-token possession alone is insufficient. Finite heavy-query admission and complete aggregate memory/egress reservations remain in force. Decoding provides data only: consumers independently authenticate the installed native roots, current clock/controller and complete certified World preimages before accepting any effect.
